questions.text: Outline any concerns about the Acquisition’s impact on competition, including whether Herron Todd White and CJA Lee Property Valuers are close competitors. If so, identify the relevant geographic areas in which they compete and the extent to which alternative suppliers are available in each geographic area.

Explain the requirements that must be met to start supplying physical property valuation services in Australia, or to expand the range or geographic coverage of services offered. Provide recent examples of new entry or expansion where possible.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Herron Todd White and/or CJA Lee Property Valuers.
